career_launches.goal: Klaw-grab the contract's loose Thud (Module 761V7) in Minmus orbit and bring it home
career_launches.note: crewed (CommNet signal required); arrival flipped from retrograde to prograde with correct --inc-to (7.7 m/s); rendezvous held 28 m; hours of engine-only grab attempts bounced off, the Thud spun up to 160 deg/s (stopped with a moment of rails warp); raycast face maps; Jeb home, science 62.7 -> 95.2 -> RCS researched

a 90 deg plane change tuned itself onto a Minmus escape (cost ignored the orbit's energy) and a recovery burn went the wrong way (orbital_speed_at is wrong on a hyperbola); recaptured by a closed-loop retrograde burn; RCS held the Klaw square to the Thud's flat face within 0.03-0.09 m at 0.15 m/s, yet every contact bounced (0.5 m/s back) until the monopropellant ran out; Klaw diagnostics (KspBot GrappleDebug) show it armed and Ready; Jeb home

career_launches.goal: first Duna landing and return (orbit + surface science kept aboard, orbital EVA report)
career_launches.note: FIRST CREWED PLANETARY LANDING & RETURN (Valentina). First launch reverted at Duna (arrival v_inf 1364 m/s: ejection sized for Duna's mean radius, the tuner twisted the path); relaunch v_inf 1037, elliptical capture 59 x 1007 km (539 m/s), orbit science + EVA report, land_atmo died at 28 km on a kRPC chute error -> emergency script, powered landing in the Midlands at 1.4 m/s. Return: Kerbin SOI pe 204 km, a 2,200 km Mun flyby to dodge the moon-penalty tuner block, reentry, splashdown at UT ~29,356,394; Valentina recovered: funds 2.35 -> 2.53M, sci 1,329 -> 1,626 (+297); "Explore Duna" done. ~80 of the ~378 sci aboard was lost because the Duna surface goo/thermometer sat on the lander stage the old reentry code jettisons (fixed: StoreScience + collect_science before jettison); the "surface science from Duna" contract stayed open

career_launches.goal: first Moho mission: uncrewed lander (OKTO) with a science set, chemical all the way (Twin-Boar / Skipper / Poodle / Terrier lander)
career_launches.note: FIRST MOHO LANDING. Launch UT 38,426,090; the new t_apo guard held (OKTO skin ~880 K). The 2,040 m/s ejection missed Moho by ~420,000 km: burn time scaled linearly with dv, so the burn was centred 26 s late (fixed); a 77 m/s Lambert correction put it back on course (the far-out tuner had offered 390). Capture started only 117 s before the periapsis (KSP had no stage delta-v, the estimate used the Poodle alone) and was finished by hand: 38.7 x 999.6 km, then 38 x 38 km. Landing site picked where Kerbin stays above the horizon (the link); landed in the Midlands at 55.50, -169.24 (UT ~40,953,400), Terrier 296 m/s left. Science ~1,516 transmitted (high +556, low +537, surface +423); funds 3.10 -> 3.40M

career_launches.goal: Eve equatorial satellite contract (the carrier) + an uncrewed Eve surface lander with an inflatable heat shield, one launch

career_launches.goal: Eve equatorial satellite contract (the carrier) + an uncrewed Eve surface lander with an inflatable heat shield, one launch
career_launches.note: relaunch with the four tail fins (UT ~41,150,089): transonic AoA <= 1.4 deg; 79.3 x 79.5 km with the Poodle's 3,321 m/s untouched (Skipper 99 left, plan 150-250: the fins' mass and drag). Ejection 1,026 m/s (T 190 d, arrival v_inf 1,103 vs plan 850-950); the Eve miss was read before leaving Kerbin's SOI this time (34,000 km). Outside: Eve pe 29,486 km; a far-out 7.71 m/s correction came out at pe 10,358 km, inc 2.8 instead of the predicted 120 km (KSP's node prediction 185 d out is off by thousands of km: the real trim is ~20 d before the SOI). Eve SOI ~UT 45.2M, pe ~45.30M; Poodle 2,390 left, lander attached. At Eve: far-out trim 1.0 m/s (pe 119 km, inc 23.7), in-SOI 10 m/s (inc 20.05), capture 204 m/s -> 121 x 19,163 km; match-orbit 444 + 225 + 33 + 8 m/s -> equatorial contract done (+301,888). Lander release: a blind `stage` on the freshly separated lander fired the heat shield's decoupler and skipped the Terrier -> quickload (tooling) of the pre-release save UT 45,624,317, then parts driven directly. Deorbit 493 m/s, entry 4,384 m/s, 2 Mk2-R, FIRST EVE LANDING: splashed in the Eastern Sea at UT 45,817,458 (+432 sci; funds 3.65 -> 4.81M with Explore Eve). The carrier then flew to Gilly (199 + 0.12 m/s, capture 79 -> 13.7 x 13.9 km) and made the FIRST GILLY LANDING at 7.88, -109.21 (UT 46,526,189; throttle capped at TWR 531 -> 7.9 %), 28/28 parts, 2,070 m/s left; +264 surface sci, funds 4.81 -> 5.04M

career_launches.goal: contract satellite in a specific Mun orbit (inc 146.04, e 0.181, sma 803 km, LAN 275.9, argPe 177.9, 3 %) with goo, magnetometer and accelerometer (Keo Relay 3 design)
career_launches.note: launch UT 42,350,284; LKO 85 x 87 km, transfer 874 m/s (plan 852); first capture with the link forecast in flight: Kerbin hidden from pe -183 s, so the burn moved 216 s earlier (225 m/s -> 429 x 778 km); match-orbit plane 34.6 deg + trims, then an apsides rotation by hand (16 m/s radial at the orbit intersection that had the link) and a 1 m/s pe trim: every element inside KSP's windows. The contract never completed: the save held both Mun contracts as Offered while kRPC listed them active and their advances (70.9k) had been paid, a stale ContractSystem after the lab flight's scene switch (a KSP restart cleared it). A contract accepted now can't count a vessel launched before it and re-accepting would pay the advances twice, so both were skipped; Mun Sat 1 stays as a Mun relay (RA-2, 4,264 m/s). `accept` now checks the save's active count against kRPC's. Later (same session) the re-offered contract "Position Mun Sat 1 in an adjusted orbit of the Mun" (inc 134.70, e 0.240, sma 859.5 km) was flown with the first `match-orbit` (125 + 47 + 17.4 + 0.6 m/s): contract done, +61,774

career_launches.goal: first Eeloo mission: uncrewed orbiter + lander (OKTO), Dres 1's lander on Moho 1's Twin-Boar launcher/transfer stage (52 parts, 138.7 t)
career_launches.note: launch UT 43,560,016; pad check matched (1421 SL / 1184 SL / 3414 / 3683); ap 46 km at 3:00, AoA peak 7.7 deg at q 1.3 kPa, 79.3 x 79.5 km, Poodle 2,796 (plan ~2,860). Ejection 1,958 m/s (plan 1,960-2,000), T 1,198 d, arrival v_inf 2,208, Eeloo +5,191 Mm out of plane; Poodle 806 left, Terrier 3,683. Sun orbit 13.30 x 69.02 Gm. The plane change must be early (UT 51.15-53.3M, ~380-450 m/s), not at the planner's UT 66.7M. Arrival ~UT 69.4M. Mid-course at UT 51.15M: direct 3D Lambert 381.1 m/s (plan 380-450), pure normal; burned 381 (residual 0.2) -> Sun orbit inc 5.75, Eeloo encounter, SOI UT 69.10M (pass pe 1,094 km, inc 175 retro: trim ~20 d out and in-SOI `correct --inc-to 0` left). Poodle 425, Terrier 3,683

career_launches.goal: uncrewed Duna surface probe (OKTO) for the contract "Science data from surface of Duna" (132,825), one way, everything transmitted
career_launches.note: launch UT 44,620,014; pad matched (1436/1549/2466/1947); clean ascent (AoA <= 0.5), 79.7 x 79.9 km with the Skipper finishing the orbit: Poodle 2,466 untouched. `transfer Duna --plan` failed twice (v_inf error 149.9): the optimal ejection path crossed the Mun's SOI; waited 14,000 s, then 1,089.8 m/s, Duna pe 1,401 km, v_inf 720 (Poodle 1,387 left). Before leaving Kerbin's SOI: Duna pe 11,881 km, inc 169 (retro); trims ~UT 51.18M and inside the SOI (51.61M). Trim 20 d out: the far-out `correct` search stayed on the retrograde side; by hand 28.2 m/s (line search across the centre) -> pe 239 km, inc 1.9. Duna SOI UT 51.617M (v_inf 721), capture 351 m/s -> 100.2 x 999.2 km, circularized 100 km. Deorbit over the plain at lon 25-50 (highlands at lon -10 avoided): LANDED at 1.02, 24.97 (UT ~51.693M), 26/26 parts; contract "Science data from surface of Duna" done (+132,825); science +709 transmitted. The Mk2-R part test (8-10 km, 550-590 m/s) was missed on the entry (359 m/s at 8 km: drag 4.3 m/s2 at q 4 kPa), then flown as a `test-hop` from the surface: staged at 8,993 m / 555 m/s, contract done (+405,000); the climb cost ~1,370 m/s (offline 930, transonic drag), 157 left; emergency descent (broadside fall, flip at 2 km, full thrust from 714 m) -> touchdown with 0.0 fuel, 26/26 parts, lying on its side at 0.99, 33.17. Funds 5.20 -> 5.74M, rep 600

bugs_found_and_fixed_fun: ascent autopilot flew nose-down at full thrust (Orbiter 1)
SRB stack 0.4° off axis = 26 kN·m torque vs a 5 kN·m wheel
autostrut on side boosters → explosion at t=0
kRPC biome lookup wants radians, not degrees → every biome-targeted landing looked at the wrong spot
Communotron antenna never unfolded → science 'transmitted' silently failed
survey waypoints accepted mid-flight don't count until a scene reload
kRPC launches straight into flight without saving: contracts accepted at the space center came back as 'offered', the rescue kerbal vanished, the advances stayed
`eva report` after a failed EVA ran every experiment on the ship; the stock Reset saved the single-use ones
the moon-return tuner happily picked the retrograde root: 65 m/s more and a hotter entry
a kerbal climbing out of the science lab kicks the whole 87 t rocket hard enough to knock it off the launch pad
a rescued engineer is crew but not a pilot: behind Minmus the probe lost its link and our burn guard decided nobody could steer
